releases.title: Desktop app on GitHub
notes: Leatherme is a desktop app you download from GitHub Releases.
Windows (.exe), macOS (.dmg), and Linux (.AppImage) builds are attached to each release.
Pushing to main publishes a new GitHub Release and uploads the apps.
Installed copies update themselves from GitHub.

releases.title: Releases page
notes: Added a Releases page with the full version history.

releases.title: First workbench
notes: Turn closed leather outlines into 3D-printable stencil plates.
Import SVG, PDF, ASCII DXF, or a high-contrast image.
Ignore open fold lines and even inset stitch guides.
2D outline and 3D orbit previews, STL and 3MF export.
